ORDINANCE IX OF 2011
ORDINANCE IX OF 2011
SINDH LAND REVENUE (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2011
An Ordinance to amend the Sindh Land Revenue Act,
1967, in order to promote peace and harmony
in the Province
of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I,
6th August, 2011]
No.S.LEGIS: 1(9)/2011, dated 6-8-2011.---The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Sindh is
hereby published for general information:--
Preamble.--
Whereas it is expedient to provide for congenial atmosphere and to
promote peace and harmony in the Province
of Sindh
and make appropriate amendment in the Sindh Land
Revenue Act, 1967, in the manner hereinafter reappearing;
And whereas the Provincial Assembly is
not in session and the Governor is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the
Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh
Land Revenue (Amendment) Ordinance, 2011.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 9 of West Pakistan Act No.XVII of 1967

No.S.LEGIS: 1(9)/2011, dated 6-8-2011.---The

And whereas the Provincial Assembly is

Now,
therefore, in exercise
of the powers
conferred by clause (1) of
Article 128 of the Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, 1973, the
Governor is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--
2. Amendment of section 9 of West Pakistan
Act No.XVII of 1967.---In the Sindh
Land Revenue Act, 1967, in section 9, the full stop at the end shall be
replaced by a colon and thereafter the following proviso shall be added:--
"Provided that this section shall not
apply to the Districts of Hyderabad and Karachi.".
